subject.title: [Bug]: custom Xiaomi MiMo models generate invalid max_completion_tokens when maxTokens is not specified

question: Which linked fix PR should be the canonical implementation for the custom Xiaomi omitted-`maxTokens` failure?
rationale: The issue is real and still present on current main, but four open PRs already claim the fix with different tradeoffs and proof states, so a maintainer should choose the landing path instead of ClawSweeper queuing another competing branch.

options.title: Land the narrow model-resolution fix
options.body: Review and land a clean proof-positive PR that stops `resolveConfiguredFallbackModel` from fabricating an output cap when none was configured, then close the remaining duplicate fix PRs.

options.title: Adopt a conservative default cap
options.body: Choose a small default output cap such as 8192 only if maintainers want an explicit cap even when users omit `maxTokens`, and require docs/tests for that contract.

options.title: Wait for live Xiaomi proof
options.body: Keep the issue and linked PRs open until a live Xiaomi request confirms the selected branch behavior against the provider.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow model-resolution fix
recommendation.body: Review and land a clean proof-positive PR that stops `resolveConfiguredFallbackModel` from fabricating an output cap when none was configured, then close the remaining duplicate fix PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent adjacent transport history and the shallow current blame points through the inspected provider/runtime lines, making him the best available routing candidate for choosing between fix shapes.
